tools.name: list_monitored_vendors
tools.description: List monitored SaaS and infrastructure vendors with public incident status data, including SolarWinds, Zscaler, Cloudflare, and others.

tools.name: get_vendor_incidents
tools.description: Get vendor incident and outage status for one monitored vendor (for example solarwinds, zscaler, cloudflare). Anonymous and active-only calls return the most recent ongoing incidents (not monitoring). Authenticated calls can request resolved history within the user plan window.

tools.name: get_all_vendor_incidents
tools.description: Get the most recent ongoing vendor incidents across all monitored vendors (newest start first). Anonymous maximum is 5. Does not include monitoring-phase incidents unless authenticated history is requested.
